DSH Unreal Bridge 0.6.5

1. Install DeepSeek Harness.
2. Double-click install-dsh.bat.
3. Fully exit DSH (including the tray) and reopen it.

The installer defaults to the desktop profile and needs no project source or system Node.js.
Internet access may be required to install npm dependencies.
Compiled JavaScript remains readable; this package is not source encryption.
